newsitem.title: USA: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 577 contracts.
newsitem.headline: CBOT overnight Project A ag volume 577 contracts.

text.p: Chicago Board of Trade said its Project A overnight agricultural contracts trading volume totalled 577 contracts, compared with 1,230 contracts traded overnight Tuesday.
There were 63 wheat, 244 corn, 247 soybean, 9 soymeal and 8 soyoil futures contracts traded along with four corn call and two soybean call options.

In overnight trading, wheat was 1/4 to 1/2 cent per bushel higher, corn was one cent lower to 1/4 higher, soybeans unchanged to 1-1/4 cent higher, soymeal steady to $0.50 per ton higher and soyoil unchanged to 0.06 cent per lb higher.
